topics.evidence: Identity, scope, and the five build phases are explicit. The eight included points are not claimed as implemented.
Repository areas and their responsibilities are mapped.
The old Worker path and the Manufact server are separated. The new server refuses the old host and old Hyperdrive id and has no database connection.
Prerequisites and reproducible local commands are documented, including the 401 blocker.
Manufact deployment c0be2dd3 is running. Phase-1 tools are registered. MySQL is not connected, no CRM read is proven, and phases 2 through 5 are not built.
The Linear tracker is authoritative and ACT-140 through ACT-154 are mapped. Its title Lena was rejected on 5 October 2026.
DEC-2026-10-06-phased-scope includes all eight points. The first four are phase 1. Own screens, TypeSafe, writes/export/import, and ranking/photos/biometrics are phases 2 through 5.
The next step is a new connection to the same MySQL database. Manufact hosting and WorkOS discovery are recorded as checked, not as a finished CRM read.
Canonical sources, update triggers and verification rules are defined.
Current, historical and superseded sources are indexed with status.
Trigger, before/after state, boundary and verification limits are recorded.
Local checks and acceptance criteria are documented; unexecuted live checks are not claimed as passed.
Phase 1 read tools are specified. TypeSafe is phase 3, writes/export/import are phase 4, and ranking/photos/biometrics are phase 5. None of those later tools is exposed.
Birth date and eu_buerger are in phase 1. WorkOS roles are not enforced in tool handlers. Raw citizenship, gender, religion, health, ethnic origin, SELECT *, and URL tokens stay excluded.
